  "evidence_supports_conclusion": "yes",
  "evidence_note": "All KPI metrics show a clear increase in PRB utilization and packet counts while radio quality remains flat, indicating a traffic load increase.",
  "unsupported_claims_in_conclusion": [
    "Method: 'changed' means |shift| > 2x baseline std and > 5 % of |baseline| (BLER also >= 0.01); 'roughly flat' also needs < 20 % relative change.",
    "PRB_Utilization is a percent of the cell's 106 PRBs per the TelecomTS paper; in unaffected rows PRBs_*_Current = 1.06 x PRB_Utilization_* exactly, confirming the scale."
  ],
  "citations": [
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 28.552",
      "section": "5.1.1.2.1 DL Total PRB Usage",
      "role_claimed": "definition",
      "passage_supports_explanation": "partial",
      "role_correct": true,
      "note": "Provides the definition of DL PRB usage, useful for understanding the metric but does not explain the cause."
    },
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 28.552",
      "section": "5.1.1.2.2 UL Total PRB Usage",
      "role_claimed": "definition",
      "passage_supports_explanation": "partial",
      "role_correct": true,
      "note": "Defines UL PRB usage; similar limitation as the DL definition."
    },
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 38.300",
      "section": "10.1 Basic Scheduler Operation",
      "role_claimed": "mechanism",
      "passage_supports_explanation": "yes",
      "role_correct": true,
      "note": "Describes how the scheduler allocates resources based on UE buffer status and QoS, linking increased traffic to higher PRB usage."
    },
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 38.300",
      "section": "15.5.1.2 Load reporting for intra-RAT and intra-system inter-RAT load balancing",
      "role_claimed": "mechanism",
      "passage_supports_explanation": "yes",
      "role_correct": true,
      "note": "Specifies that per‑cell PRB usage is used as a load indicator, supporting the interpretation of rising PRB utilization as rising load."
    }
  ],
  "has_adequate_mechanism_citation": true,
  "acceptable_conclusions_reasonable": true,
  "uncertainty_honest_and_complete": true,

    "Remove or qualify the unsupported methodological claim about the statistical thresholds for 'changed' and 'roughly flat'.",
